description: Java class implementing a rule node for publishing messages to RabbitMQ within the Thingsboard platform. It manages connection setup, message publishing, and error handling.

classes.name: TbRabbitMqNode
classes.description: Java class for a rule node that publishes messages to RabbitMQ, handling connection management, message publishing, and error processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, sets up RabbitMQ connection and channel.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, publishes them asynchronously, and manages success or failure callbacks.

methods.name: getConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory based on node configuration.

methods.name: publishMessage
methods.description: Publishes a message to RabbitMQ with processed exchange and routing key, and message properties.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Processes exceptions by adding error info to message metadata.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Closes RabbitMQ connection during node shutdown.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a string message property type to RabbitMQ BasicProperties.
